questions.prompt: ★ What happens when you momentarily press 1PB in this diagram?
options: The cylinder extends only while 1PB is held
The cylinder extends to 1LS and stops there
The cylinder extends to 1LS, then retracts
The cylinder extends and retracts continuously
questions.answer: The cylinder extends to 1LS, then retracts
questions.explanation: 1CRA seals in the relay until the extending cylinder operates 1LS. That opens the holding path, drops SOL and lets the spring-return valve retract the cylinder.

questions.prompt: ★ Start PB1 has been pressed momentarily. What happens when the limit switch closes?
options: The green and red lights turn on
The green and red lights turn off
The green light turns on and red turns off
The green light turns off and red turns on
questions.answer: The green light turns on and red turns off
questions.explanation: 1CR is held by 1CR-A. Closing LS energizes 2CR through 1CR-B. Then 2CR-A closes the green path and 2CR-B opens the red path.
